examples.name: Default
examples.summary: Default empty password input with the visibility toggle enabled.

examples.name: Toggle
examples.summary: `toggleable=true` (default) renders the visibility toggle button on the trailing edge; `toggleable=false` renders a plain password field and frees the `iconRight` slot.

examples.name: IconLeft
examples.summary: Leading `iconLeft` slot — the only icon slot honored when `toggleable=true`.

examples.name: Filled
examples.summary: Pre-populated `modelValue` shows the filled visual state and the masked rendering (driven by `:not(:placeholder-shown)`).

examples.name: Invalid
examples.summary: Invalid state — applies danger border/ring tokens and `aria-invalid`.

examples.name: MaxLength
examples.summary: Hard character cap of 8 enforced by the native `maxlength` attribute.

examples.name: Monospace
examples.summary: An API token field: `monospace` draws the value in the code face, so the revealed token reads character by character; `autocomplete="off"` keeps password managers away.

examples.name: Disabled
examples.summary: Disabled state — the toggle button inherits the disabled state.
